feeds.what: R.eit, R.totalMWh (IT × PUE × 8760) → water demand basis
H.healthCost → monetized health damages in the cost-benefit ledger (CM.costs, CM.netCommunityValue)
L.esvLost → ecosystem-service loss in the cost-benefit ledger
F.lostRev → agricultural revenue loss in the cost-benefit ledger
R.totalC → lifecycle carbon and embodied share (EW.lcCarbon, EW.embodiedPct)
R.totalMWh, R.renewProcuredPct → regional grid-attributable NOx/SO2/PM2.5 burden = delivered kWh × subregion output rates × EPA benefit-per-ton (H.grid*, H.totalHealthCost)
R.totalMWh → facility-scale exposure factor (SC.scaleFactor); severed → falls back to serverCount

summary.definition: Legacy COMPARISON definition (all nine severable feeds); the manuscript definition of sequential review is E5b tier1_2 (tiers 1-2 severed, the tier-3 scale proxy kept) - see E5b_tiered.csv. Siloed = each engine receives the permit-application facility profile and the tier-0 identity arithmetic derived from it (IT×PUE×8760, MW÷grid MW: feeds R>W, R>G, R>GR, R>SM are always kept), but none of the tier-1 model outputs of other sectors (W>F, R>L, H>CM, L>CM, F>CM, R>EW, L>UHI), the tier-2 scope-boundary feed (R>H) or the tier-3 scale proxy (R>SC). See E5b for the tiered variants and E5c for the exact Shapley attribution. Coupled = full NEXUS FORGE propagation as implemented in NexusContext.jsx.
